Un intruso raramente ottiene tutto ciò c: An intruder rarely gets everything they want on first access. To stay in the system after a reboot or a password change, they use persistence techniques; to avoid being noticed by antivirus, EDR and analysts, they use evasion techniques. These are the phases in which an attack can go on for weeks without anyone noticing.
Conoscerle serve a sapere dove guardare:: Knowing them tells you where to look: every persistence mechanism leaves a trace (a registry key, a service, a scheduled task) and every evasion attempt produces signals that good monitoring can pick up. The sooner you find the persistence, the shorter the intruder’s dwell time and the smaller the damage.
Le schede descrivono cosa fa ogni tecnic: The cards describe what each technique does and how to recognise it, not how to carry it out. Use this knowledge only on systems you own or for which you have written authorisation: read Ethics and law before experimenting in a lab.

<strong>Come usare questa pagina.</stron: How to use this page. Filter by category or search by name, MITRE ATT&CK ID (for example T1055) or keyword (for example WMI). Each card covers, in order: what the technique does, the signs to look for, how to detect it and how to prevent it. The table at the end compares the techniques to help you decide where to start. The examples focus on Windows, the platform on which these techniques are most often documented. For a specific malware family (Emotet, LockBit…) see the Malware catalogue; for threat types (worms, ransomware…) the Malware taxonomy; for real cases the Historic breaches.
Cerca per nome, ID (T1055) o parola chia: Search by name, ID (T1055) or keyword (WMI)
Nessuna tecnica corrisponde alla ricerca: No technique matches your search or the selected filter.
Ogni tecnica ha tre valori su una scala: Each technique has three ratings on a low / medium / high scale. They are qualitative estimates for teaching purposes, not measurements: in your environment they may differ considerably depending on the logs you collect and the tools you have. The colour shows who has the advantage: green favours the defender, red the attacker.
Quanto la tecnica è discreta. Alta: lasc: How discreet the technique is. High: it leaves few traces visible to a routine check. Low: looking in the right place is enough to spot it.
Quanto spesso la tecnica compare negli i: How often the technique appears in incidents and public threat intelligence reports. High: it is among the first things to check.
Quanto è difficile accorgersene. Bassa:: How hard it is to notice. Low: a dedicated log event or a tool such as Autoruns is enough. High: you need advanced telemetry (EDR, a well-tuned Sysmon configuration) or memory analysis.
Una tecnica con prevalenza alta e diffic: A technique with high prevalence and low detection difficulty is the first check to automate; one with high detection difficulty calls for investment in telemetry and analysis skills.
